summary: With a pre-login pool (no mass signup), feed/API stayed fast but connection failures rose above ~100 concurrent VUs. Comfortable pure-API target ~80–100 concurrent sessions; 200 VUs hit 13% failures.
notes: 25 pre-authenticated tokens reused across up to 200 VUs
Successful requests stayed very fast (overall p95 ~35ms, feed p95 ~43ms)
Failures were mostly dial/connect timeouts as VUs climbed past ~100
Compared to signup-ramp test (~70 comfortable): auth signup is tighter; logged-in API ceiling is higher
